title: Store launch: one warm golden shop inside Telegram (for the future owner)

beats.role: own your store inside a chat — no app, no site
what your customers do in one pass: choose, pay from balance, receive in seconds
the owner's phone: pulse, orders, broadcast, stats + the capability strip
the vault: PIN fills, guards land, the riser rises
the drop, the end ticket, and the only two contacts

rules: Product UI is quoted, not restyled: the screens use the real Mini App's Reem Kufi + IBM Plex Sans Arabic scale inside the phone.
Headline words land whole; never split Arabic into letters, never track Arabic.
Saffron is money and impact only, never body copy or decoration.

reference.move: The shop grows out of the chat bubble inside one continuous move; a new UI state lands on every bar, and the only hard cut is the drop.
reference.note: Pattern adapted from the four pinned reference cards (one-take flood handoff, 120 BPM event-per-bar, whole-word Arabic kinetic type, macro-to-context scale reveal); no frames, prompts or assets were copied.

guardrails: Public film: no SaaS/tenant/platform vocabulary, no invented metrics or social proof.
The store name and its numbers are the app's own sample data and are labelled as such on the end card.
One drop only; no second shockwave, no glitch, no neon.
Contacts are the only numbers in the film, printed exactly as supplied.
